title: 3.9 Jobs
unit_title: Unit 3: Me, You and Other People
unit_outcome: Greet people, say who you are, your age, where you are from and your job, and say what belongs to whom.
goal: Name six jobs in the male and female form and ask Was bist du von Beruf?
grammar_function: Was bist du von Beruf? Ich bin + job (no article). Er ist Arzt. Sie ist Ärztin.
speaking_outcome: Ask and say what someone's job is.
